title: Cairo Crowdfunder
tagline: Toy version of a crowdfunding contract in Cairo. My first Cairo contract.
description:
This project is a simplistic implementation of a Crowdfunding contract. It allows anyone to create campaigns and to fund active campaigns.

how_its_made:
Initially I set up the cairo devenv (scarb, starkli) and learned how to build and deploy contracts. Then I looked at the Cairo examples and attempted to implement the functionalities the best I could in a mix of Cairo and rust. Following that I started fixing compilation errors and had to go find and use the actual Cairo syntax.
